product_one_liner.value: Scandit provides smart data-capture software—using vision AI for barcode, ID and label scanning and shelf intelligence—to help enterprises automate workflows and gain real-time insights from physical operations.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as enterprise smart data capture powered by vision AI.

pricing_page.notes: Public page describes fixed and flexible pricing options and quotes, even though it does not publish a simple rate card.

named_customers.notes: The Scandit customer-stories page and company AI information page identify these as customers.

employee_band.notes: Scandit's LinkedIn company profile lists 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company identifies Zurich as its global headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company says it was founded in 2009.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple technical posts explaining the product's vision-AI/ML systems and SDK implementation, authored by CTO and co-founder Christian Floerkemeier.

public_docs.notes: Scandit has a public developer documentation portal with SDK/framework integration guides and multiple product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers snapshot showed nine active openings on 2026-11-09; none of the listed titles was AI, ML, machine learning, data science, research science, NLP, LLM or computer vision. The Senior Backend Engineer and Product Engineer titles do not qualify under the stated title criteria.

model_provider.value: Scandit's proprietary in-house Vision AI Engine; no external model provider is identified.
model_provider.notes: Scandit publicly describes its own Vision AI Engine and the subprocessors page does not identify an external AI model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page identifies ISO 27001:2022 certification and says Scandit complies with applicable privacy regulations including GDPR. It does not claim SOC 2, HIPAA or PCI DSS on that page.

last_funding.notes: The announced Series D was $150 million in February 2022; company and funding-database results identify it as the latest reported round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported round was in February 2022, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current openings snapshot listed a Business Development Representative – French Speaker role, which meets the stated SDR/BDR criterion.

launched_6mo.notes: Scandit announced its Self-Checkout Loss Prevention solution on 2026-09-15, within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete current leadership page lists the small global leadership team but does not identify a C-level or VP arrival in the 12-month window; no departure or appointment announcement in that period was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Scandit Key Account Manager posting names Salesforce, Gong, Highspot and DealHub. Scandit's Built In profile lists Salesforce, Marketo, SalesLoft, ZoomInfo and MixRank among its sales/marketing technologies.
